action: extend one boundary or sectional face outward
divergence: Measured on a bare extruded body, uncut by the envelope: massv2 expand adds 845 m3 (add) acting on 1 volume(s) (single). The BOOK records this word as add on single volumes. The two agree on both counts, so the second implementation is a restatement rather than a different word - it may still differ in proportion, which this bench does not measure.

mathematical_basis.reference: Rossignac, J. & Requicha, A.A.G. (1986) 'Offsetting operations in solid modelling', Computer Aided Geometric Design 3(2)
mathematical_basis.definition: Every boundary point moves outward along its normal by a fixed distance - the Minkowski sum with a ball. Strictly additive.

delivery_contract.why: A unary AST chain, a decompose() != 1 refusal inside every macro, and a maximum_components=1 promotion gate. The reason is written in candidate_analysis.py: a detached piece is no more architectural than a small Lego speck, and split wings or arrays must be joined by an explicit bridge or spine.
delivery_contract.note: So the BOOK record's `multiple` means how many volumes the operative involves, NOT how many bodies come back.
